data.rationale: The proposal matches the true goal and step order (open BOOK > Map search, type origin, pick the airport, set options, Search, review the list). It adds max_price and trip_type parameters that the true workflow doesn't have, and it names the search type and flexible dates only loosely, so the steps are concrete enough to automate but a few parameters are slightly off.
